text: An agent can register itself with a human's email and receive an API key, inbox ID, and organization ID
quote: The agent registers itself using the human email you provide and gets back an API key, inbox ID, and organization ID.

text: Agents can sign up without a human email to get a receive-only inbox, and attach a human later via API
quote: No human email yet? Leave `human_email` out to get a receive-only inbox, then attach a human later with `POST /v0/agent/human`

text: Create tens, hundreds, or thousands of inboxes for agents on demand
quote: You can create tens, hundreds, or even thousands of Inboxes for your agents on demand.

text: Create, manage, and operate email inboxes entirely through an API
quote: Create, manage, and operate email inboxes entirely via API.

text: Gives agents their own inboxes to send, receive, and act on emails
quote: It gives agents their own inboxes to send, receive, and act upon emails.

text: Start new conversations by sending a message from one of your inboxes
quote: To start a new conversation, you can send a Message from one of your inboxes.

text: CC or BCC a real person on agent-sent messages for human-in-the-loop oversight and escalation
quote: You can cc or bcc a real person on any message your agent sends, creating a "human-in-the-loop" workflow for oversight, escalations, or quality assurance.

text: Agents can create drafts of sensitive messages that a human reviews and approves before sending
quote: Human-in-the-Loop Review: An agent can create a `Draft` for a sensitive or important `Message`, which a human can then review and approve before it's sent.

text: Full-text search finds threads by keyword across sender, recipients, subject, and body, ranked by relevance
quote: Full-text search finds Threads by keyword across the sender, recipients, subject, and message body, ranked by relevance.

text: Register a webhook URL to receive POST requests when email events happen, instead of polling
quote: you can register a URL, and we will send you a `POST` request with the details as soon as an event happens.

text: Persistent WebSocket connection for real-time email events without needing a public URL or ngrok
quote: WebSockets provide a persistent, bidirectional connection to AgentMail for receiving email events in real-time.

text: Connect Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail, or any IMAP/SMTP client to an AgentMail inbox
quote: **Email Client Integration**: Connect Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail, or any IMAP/SMTP-compatible client to your AgentMail inbox

text: Multi-tenant setup: one pod per customer, with scoped API keys and webhook routing per tenant
quote: The basic idea: create a `Pod` per customer, give them a scoped API key, and route webhook events to the right place.

text: Pods fully isolate each customer's data
quote: Pods provide complete isolation between your customers' data

text: Scoped API keys can be restricted to a single pod or a single inbox
quote: Scoped API keys restrict access to a single pod or a single inbox.

text: Permissions limit which actions an API key can perform
quote: `Permissions` let you restrict what an API key can do.

text: Send from your own custom domains to control sending reputation and support high-volume outreach
quote: It gives you control over your sending reputation and enables advanced strategies for high-volume outreach.

text: Hosted MCP server exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, and calendar tools to compatible clients
quote: AgentMail runs a hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.agentmail.to/mcp` that exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, and calendar tools to any compatible client

text: CLI to create inboxes, send messages, and manage threads, shipped as a single native binary with no runtime dependencies
quote: Create inboxes, send messages, manage threads, and more — all without writing code. It ships as a single native binary with no runtime dependencies.

text: Python SDK for integrating with Python applications
quote: Use our Python SDK for seamless integration with your Python applications.

text: All SDKs are open source under the MIT license
quote: All of our SDKs are open source and available under the MIT license.

text: String-based labels can be attached to messages and threads to track conversation state
quote: `Labels` are simple, string-based tags that you can attach to your `Messages` and `Threads`.

text: Allow and block lists filter email by specific addresses or domains
quote: `Lists` allow you to filter emails by allowing or blocking specific email addresses or domains.

text: Agents can send attachments on outgoing messages and process attachments on incoming ones
quote: Your agents can both send `Attachments` in outgoing `Messages` and process `Attachments` from incoming `Messages`.

text: Retrieve messages scoped to a single inbox or across the whole organization
quote: you can retrieve them in two powerful ways: scoped to a single `Inbox` or across your entire `Organization`.

text: AgentID lets agents sign in to apps using an AgentMail inbox as their identity
quote: AgentID lets agents sign in to apps using an AgentMail inbox as their identity.

text: Installable agent skills for Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, Codex, and other compatible agents
quote: This works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, Codex, and other compatible agents: npx skills add agentmail-to/agentmail-skills

text: A single command installs both the email skill and the email channel
quote: One command installs both the email skill and the email channel.

text: Agents can create inboxes, send and receive email, manage threads, and handle attachments using natural language
quote: your agent can create inboxes, send and receive emails, manage threads, and handle attachments using natural language.

text: LangGraph integration lets an agent send, reply, draft, label, and search email through a real inbox without glue code
quote: so a LangGraph agent can send, reply, draft, label, and search email through a real inbox without any glue code.

text: Load messages as LangChain Documents and index them in a vector store for semantic search across the inbox
quote: **RAG over email:** Load messages as LangChain `Document`s and index them into a vector store for semantic search across the inbox.

text: Each bot gets a real inbox with its own address, threading, inbound webhooks, and reply-to-message
quote: AgentMail gives each bot a real inbox with its own address, threading, inbound webhooks, and reply-to-message.

text: Sim integration lets workflows create inboxes, send and receive mail, manage drafts and labels without backend code
quote: By connecting AgentMail to Sim, your workflows can create inboxes, send and receive emails, manage threads, handle drafts, and organize conversations with labels, all without writing backend code.

text: Agents can pay for API usage directly over HTTP via x402, without API keys or subscriptions
quote: By integrating x402 with AgentMail, your agents can pay for API usage directly over HTTP without managing API keys or subscriptions.

text: Agents can pay for API usage via MPP, without API keys or subscriptions
quote: By integrating MPP with AgentMail, your agents can pay for API usage directly without managing API keys or subscriptions.

text: Guide for building a voice assistant with real-time email capabilities
quote: This guide walks you through building a voice assistant with real time email capabilites.

text: Conversational agents can reply to incoming emails within seconds
quote: Real-Time Speed:** Build conversational agents that can reply to incoming emails in seconds.

text: No restrictive rate limits or sending limits for high-volume use
quote: **High-Volume Ready**: No restrictive rate or sending limits.

text: Blueprint tool turns a project description into a plan, with a prompt a coding agent can build from
quote: Describe what you are working on and get a blueprint back, with a prompt your coding agent can build from.

text: Free tier includes 3 inboxes and 100 emails per day with no credit card required
quote: The free tier includes 3 inboxes and 100 emails per day, no credit card required.

text: Developer plan costs $20/month for 10 inboxes, 10,000 emails/month, 10 GB storage, and 10 custom domains
quote: Developer For individual developers $20/month 10 inboxes 10,000 emails/month 10 GB storage 10 custom domains

text: Usage-based pricing: pay only for what you use
quote: They charge monthly subscriptions per inbox($12/inbox/month !!)... Usage-Based Pricing: Pay only for what you use.

text: Add-ons can be changed any time: increases are prorated, and reductions take effect at renewal
quote: Add or remove them any time from Billing in the console: increases are prorated for the rest of the period, reductions take effect at renewal.

text: SOC 2 Type II compliant, with a Trust Center showing live control status and the report available on request
quote: **AgentMail is SOC 2 Type II compliant.**

text: An agent can register programmatically without using the Console or dashboard.
quote: For agents that sign themselves up programmatically, no Console or dashboard needed.

text: The OpenClaw integration adds two-way email conversations alongside existing chat channels.
quote: By adding AgentMail to OpenClaw, your agent gains the ability to send and receive emails, enabling two-way email conversations alongside your existing chat channels.

text: Connect AgentMail in Replit by pasting an AgentMail Console API key.
